summary: Live Oak Acquisition Corp. V filed an 8-K disclosing a Forward Purchase Agreement with a fund sub-advised by JBA Asset Management in connection with its proposed business combination with Teamshares Inc. The trust account redemption price per share as of June 8, 2026, is $10.55. The Forward Purchase Transaction is designed to close after the extraordinary general meeting of Live Oak shareholders. No financial terms, premium, or advisor names are provided. The transaction is subject to shareholder approval and customary closing conditions. Watch for shareholder vote results and potential redemptions affecting the trust.
